# Overview
1. During which developmental stages should chemicals be applied to reduce disease severity of Pseudocercospora spot and rot disease?

2. Is disease severity higher at certain parts of the plant (i.e. cordon, middle or tip of branch)?

# Import and filter dataset

```{r data-prep}
#Set working directory and import dataset 
dat <- read_excel("../data/Pseudocercospora_disease_severity_Aug2026.xlsx",  sheet= "DSI",  col_types = c("text", "text", "numeric",
        "text", "text", "numeric",
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

dat <- dat %>% 
  mutate(
     Treatment_period = case_when( # collapse some stage treatments into 3 categories
      Stage == "Control" ~ "Control", 
      Stage == "Curative" ~"Curative",
      Stage == "Full_cover" ~"Full_cover",
      Stage == "Flowering" ~ "Flowering", 
      Stage %in% c("Bud_break",  "Flower_buds") ~ "Pre-fruit development",
      Stage %in% c("Halfway_expanded","Fruit_set",
        "End_expansion",
        "Fruit_development",
        "Month_before_harvest") ~ "Post-fruit development",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Treatment_period = factor(
      Treatment_period,
      levels = c(
        "Control", "Curative", "Full_cover",
        "Pre-fruit development", "Flowering",
        "Post-fruit development"
      )
    ),
    Province = as.factor(Province),
    Season = as.factor (Season),
     Stage = factor(
      Stage,
      levels = c(
        "Control","Bud_break","Flower_buds","Flowering", "Fruit_set", "Halfway_expanded", "End_expansion","Fruit_development", "Curative", 
        "Month_before_harvest", "Full_cover")
    )
  )


levels(dat$Stage)
levels(dat$Treatment_period)

dat %>%
  count(Province, Season, Stage) %>%
  count(Province, Season, name = "n_stages") %>%
  kable(caption= "Number ofsprays per Season x Province")

# check the number of replicates by experimental grouping

head(dat)
hist(dat$Overall)

str(dat)
table(dat$Stage)
table(dat$Season)
table(dat$Province)

with(dat, table(Stage, Season))

with(dat, table(Season, Treatment_period))
with(dat, table(Stage, Province))
```

## GLM Model for Overall DSI by Stage
  
Methods description:

Notes:

The experimental design has a low sample size (3 per stage treatment) but each of the 11 stage treatments were not uniformly distributed among Seasons and Provinces. 

- The following treatments were conducted in each Season:  Control, Bud_break, Flowering, Fruit_set, Curative, and Full_Cover

- The following treatments were conducted in each Province: Control, Bud_break, Flower_buds, Flowering, Fruit_set, Fruit_development, Curative, and Full_Cover

- The following treatments were conducted in only one Season: 2024/2025: Flower_buds, Fruit_development; 2025/2026: Halfway_expanded, End_expansion, Month_before_harvest

- The following treatments were conducted in only one Province: KZN: End_expansion and Month_before_harvest                               

These observations prevent fitting a model with a 3-way: DSI ~ Stage X Season X Province model.

**Model 1 - All treatments:** To retain the maximum amount of statistical power I  fit the model: DSI ~ Stage X Season + Province.

We modeled disease severity index (DSI) using a generalized linear model (GLM fitted with glmmTMB in R). DSI was expressed as a proportion and adjusted for observations at the boundary of zero so that all values fell within the interval (0, 1). The model assumed a beta-distributed response with a logit link and included disease-development Stage, Season, and Province as fixed effects. Statistical differences of the main effects were evaluated with Tukey test of the least squared means.


**Model 2:** Since the replication is so low per treatment I  wonder what information you would be giving up by collapsing treatments End_expansion and Month_before_harvest as "Fruit Development"



## **Model 1 - All treatments** 


Below a variety of model structures were fit to assess goodness of fit and appropriateness of model structure and associated information content. 


```{r  mixed model}

 is.factor(dat$Stage);is.factor(dat$Season)


############################################################################
# Fit model with Season and Province as fixed effects
############################################################################

model <- lm(
  Overall ~ Stage + Season + Province, data = dat)

summary(model)
anova(model) # test the fixed effect of Stage
plot(model); qqnorm(residuals(model)); qqline(residuals(model)) # check model assumptions

# model resids don't look good

############################################################################
# Fit and compare models with a beta distribution
############################################################################

# create new dataframe with updated variables

n_obs <- nrow(dat) # determine number of observations in data to scale DSI prop

model.dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    DSI_prop = Overall / 100, # convert DSI back to proportion
    DSI_beta = (DSI_prop * (n_obs - 1) + 0.5) / n_obs, # apply the Smithson–Verkuilen adjustment
    Stage = factor(Stage),
    Season = factor(Season),
    Province = factor(Province)
  )

range(model.dat$Overall, na.rm = TRUE)
range(model.dat$DSI_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
range(model.dat$DSI_beta, na.rm = TRUE)

# plot distributions of DSI_prop per stage and season
ggplot(model.dat, aes(x = DSI_prop)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~ Stage) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Disease Severity Index",
    y = "Number of observations",
    title = "Distribution of DSI by Stage"
  )

#########################################
##Fit beta dist'n models
##########################################
models <- list(

 # Stage without Season
  Stage_only =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Stage,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),
  
  # Season without Stage
  Season_only =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Season,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),
  
  # Province only
  Province_only =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Province ,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),
  
   # Stage and Season
  Stage_Season =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Stage + Season ,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),
 # Stage , Season and Prov
  Stage_Season_Prov = 
   glmmTMB(
  DSI_beta ~ Stage + Season + Province,
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = model.dat
),
  
  # Does the Stage response differ between seasons and by Province?
  Stage_Season_Interaction =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Stage * Season + Province ,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ), 
# Three_Way_Interaction =
#     glmmTMB(
#       DSI_beta ~ Stage * Season * Province ,
#       family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
#       data = model.dat
#     ),
Three_Way_Period =
    glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Treatment_period * Season * Province ,
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),

Season_rando_Stage =
  
  glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Stage * Province + (1|Season),
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    ),

Season_rando_Period =
  
  glmmTMB(
      DSI_beta ~ Treatment_period * Province + (1|Season),
      family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
      data = model.dat
    )
)



```

### Model comparison

Below is the model selection table for candidate models

```{r mod comparison, fig.height= 12, fig.width= 6}

################################################
#Model Comparisons
################################################
model_selection <- purrr::map_dfr(
  models,
  ~ tibble(
    logLik = as.numeric(logLik(.x)),
    AIC = AIC(.x),
    BIC = BIC(.x),
    npar = attr(logLik(.x), "df")
  ),
  .id = "Model"
) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    AIC_weight =
      exp(-0.5 * Delta_AIC) /
      sum(exp(-0.5 * Delta_AIC))
  )

model_selection %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Model selection results for beta mixed-effects models of disease severity index.",
    col.names = c(
      "Model",
      "Log-likelihood",
      "AIC",
      "BIC",
      "Parameters",
      "ΔAIC",
      "AIC weight"
    )
  ) 


# Compile fixed effects from all models

fixed_effects <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  models,
  function(model, model_name) {
    broom.mixed::tidy(
      model,
      effects = "fixed",
      conf.int = TRUE
    ) |>
      mutate(model = model_name, .before = 1)
  }
)

# Compare the same fixed-effect terms across models

fixed_effects |> 
  dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) |>
  arrange(term, model)

# compare fixed effects estimate by model structure

fixed_effects |>
   filter(
    !is.na(estimate),
    !is.na(conf.low),
    !is.na(conf.high)
  ) |>

ggplot(aes(x = estimate,
           y = term,
           color = model)) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = conf.low,
        xmax = conf.high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme_classic()



```

### Model diagnostics


```{r model diagnostics}

################################################
# Examine top model diagnostics and predictions
################################################

# First select a model to evaluate

model_sel<-models[["Season_rando_Stage"]]

# model coeffs are on logit scale
summary(model_sel)

# check convergence
performance::check_convergence(model_sel)

# check singularity
performance::check_singularity(model_sel)

# check zero-inflation

sum(model.dat$Overall == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

mean(model.dat$Overall == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

#residual diagnostics (DHarma)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model_sel,
  n = 1000
)

plot(simulationOutput) #approximately uniform and randomly distributed?

testUniformity(simulationOutput)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)


testCategorical(
  simulationOutput,
  catPred = model.dat$Stage
)

testCategorical(
  simulationOutput,
  catPred = model.dat$Season
)

testCategorical(
  simulationOutput,
  catPred = model.dat$Province
)


# Check the beta-model dispersion parameter

sigma(model_sel) #Higher sigma corresponds to a more concentrated beta distribution around the predicted mean

# examine random effects (if any)

ranef(model_sel) 

VarCorr(model_sel) #If the variance of Season:Province is essentially zero, there may be little detectable variation among provinces within seasons.Value is the standard deviation of the random intercept on the logit scale


```

#### Summary:

Based on the AIC and anova comparison the 3 way interaction model ranks as the top model for information content, however, the diagnostic tests suggest variance among seasons is not similar and some of the contrasts cannot be estimated because stages are missing from a season or province. 

The DSI ~ Stage + Season + Province model has arguably as much information content as does the Stage_Season_Interaction model (and it is within 2 AIC) with 5 less parameters. In some respects this model makes the most since given the unbalanced design and the diagnostics look good. It does however preclude comparisons among each factors level combination.

The fixed effects estimates were generally similar among models fit with more interaction terms: 
- DSI was greater in KZN and lower in 2025/2026 than 2024/2025
- the indiv stage treatment effects on DSI were similar among models, meaning that model structure did not influence whether the effect of a particular treatment was negative or positive. The only exception was for the Flower_buds 


Results from final model:

DSI ~ Stage + Season + Province

- there was no treatment effect in each province during the 2025/2026 season; DSI was very low <0.1

- KZN 2024/2025: Full cover, Fruit Development, and Fruit set treatments significantly reduced DSI compared to Curative, Flower Buds, Bud Break and Control. Flowering treatment was better at reducing DSI compared to the Control 

- Limpopo 2024/2025:  Full cover, Fruit Development, and Fruit set treatments significantly reduced DSI compared to Curative, Flower Buds, Bud Break and Control. Flowering treatment was better at reducing DSI compared to the Control






### Random Effects (if used)

```{r random effects, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}


# Evaluate the random effects

VarCorr(model_sel) # on logit scale


province_re <- ranef(
  model_sel,
  condVar = TRUE
)

province_re # BLUPs/conditional modes of the random effects.

confint(model_sel,  parm = "theta_") #confidence intervals for the variance parameters

# caterpillar plot
province_re <- ranef(model_sel)$cond$`Season:Province` %>%
  rownames_to_column("Season_Province") %>%
  rename(
    Random_effect = `(Intercept)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Random_effect) %>%
  mutate(
    Season_Province = factor(
      Season_Province,
      levels = Season_Province
    )
  )

ggplot(
  province_re,
  aes(
    x = Random_effect,
    y = Season_Province
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Province-within-Season random effect (logit scale)",
    y = "Season:Province",
    title = "Variation in DSI among Provinces within Seasons"
  )

# What is the estimated DSI for this particular Province, conditional on its observed data?

newdat <- model.dat %>%
  distinct(Season, Province) %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = levels(model.dat$Stage)[1]
  )

newdat$predicted_DSI <- predict(
  model_beta,
  newdata = newdat,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NULL
)

newdat <- newdat %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_DSI = predicted_DSI * 100
  )

predict(
  model_sel,
  newdata = newdat,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NULL
)

ggplot(
  newdat,
  aes(
    x = Province,
    y = predicted_DSI
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Season) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Province",
    y = "Predicted DSI (%)",
    title = "Province-specific predicted disease severity"
  )


```

## Model for DSI per plant part

```{r plt_part_mod}

m_common <- glmmTMB(
  DSI_beta ~ PlantPart + Stage + Season + Province +
    (1 | Replicate),
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = model.dat
)

m_part_effects <- glmmTMB(
  DSI_beta ~ PlantPart * (Stage + Season + Province) +
    (1 | Replicate),
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data = model.dat
)

```



# Older analyses

## Normality Checks

```{r verify-shapiro-resid}
resid_p_kzn2425 <- shapiro.test(residuals(aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2425)))$p.value
resid_p_kzn2526 <- shapiro.test(residuals(aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2526)))$p.value
resid_p_lim2425 <- shapiro.test(residuals(aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2425)))$p.value
resid_p_lim2526 <- shapiro.test(residuals(aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2526)))$p.value

check_tbl <- tibble(
  Province       = c("KwaZulu-Natal", "KwaZulu-Natal", "Limpopo", "Limpopo"),
  Season         = c("2024/2025", "2025/2026", "2024/2025", "2025/2026"),
  resid_p        = round(c(resid_p_kzn2425, resid_p_kzn2526, resid_p_lim2425, resid_p_lim2526), 4))
 
kable(check_tbl, caption = "Shapiro-Wilk p-value")

```

## Homogeneity of variance

```{r variance-checks}
car::leveneTest(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2425)
car::leveneTest(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2526)
car::leveneTest(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2425)
car::leveneTest(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2526)

```

### ANOVA & Tukey's HSD

```{r parametric-tests}
# ANOVA Summary
aov_kzn2425 <- aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2425)
aov_kzn2526 <- aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_kzn2526)
aov_lim2425 <- aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2425)
aov_lim2526 <- aov(Overall ~ Stage, data = sub_lim2526)

summary(aov_kzn2425);plot(aov_kzn2425)
summary(aov_kzn2526);plot(aov_kzn2526)
summary(aov_lim2425);plot(aov_lim2425)
summary(aov_lim2526);plot(aov_lim2526)

```
```{r Tukey post-hoc}
glht_kzn2526 <- glht(aov_kzn2526, linfct = mcp(Stage = "Tukey"))
summary(glht_kzn2526)

glht_lim2425 <- glht(aov_lim2425, linfct = mcp(Stage = "Tukey"))
summary(glht_lim2425)

glht_lim2526 <- glht(aov_lim2526, linfct = mcp(Stage = "Tukey"))
summary(glht_lim2526)


```


### Friedmans Test and Wilcoxon post-hoc
The measurements for tip, middle and cordon were repeated measurements for the same plant. 

```{r data per part}

idata_part <- data.frame(Part = factor(c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip"), levels = c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip")))
```

```{r province_season part-long}
part_long_kzn2425 <- sub_kzn2425 %>%
  mutate(Plant = interaction(Stage, Replicate, drop = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), names_to = "Part", values_to = "DSI") %>%
  mutate(Part = factor(Part, levels = c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip")))

part_long_kzn2526 <- sub_kzn2526 %>%
  mutate(Plant = interaction(Stage, Replicate, drop = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), names_to = "Part", values_to = "DSI") %>%
  mutate(Part = factor(Part, levels = c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip")))

part_long_lim2425 <- sub_lim2425 %>%
  mutate(Plant = interaction(Stage, Replicate, drop = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), names_to = "Part", values_to = "DSI") %>%
  mutate(Part = factor(Part, levels = c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip")))

part_long_lim2526 <- sub_lim2526 %>%
  mutate(Plant = interaction(Stage, Replicate, drop = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), names_to = "Part", values_to = "DSI") %>%
  mutate(Part = factor(Part, levels = c("Cordon", "Middle", "Tip")))

```

```{part-means}
sub_kzn2425 %>% summarise(across(c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), ~round(mean(.), 2)))

sub_kzn2526 %>% summarise(across(c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), ~round(mean(.), 2)))

sub_lim2425 %>% summarise(across(c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), ~round(mean(.), 2)))

sub_lim2526 %>% summarise(across(c(Cordon, Middle, Tip), ~round(mean(.), 2)))
```

```{r kzn2425-friedman}
friedman.test(DSI ~ Part | Plant, data = part_long_kzn2425)

friedman.test(DSI ~ Part | Plant, data = part_long_kzn2526)

friedman.test(DSI ~ Part | Plant, data = part_long_lim2425)

friedman.test(DSI ~ Part | Plant, data = part_long_lim2526)

```
P<0.05 is significant and post-hoc paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm-adjusted was done. 
Found neither seasons for Limpopo were significant, so no post-hoc done.

```{r Wilcoxon posthoc}
p_raw_kzn2425 <- c(
  Cordon_v_Middle = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2425$Cordon, sub_kzn2425$Middle, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  Cordon_v_Tip    = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2425$Cordon, sub_kzn2425$Tip,    paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  Middle_v_Tip    = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2425$Middle, sub_kzn2425$Tip,    paired = TRUE)$p.value
)
p.adjust(p_raw_kzn2425, method = "holm")

p_raw_kzn2526 <- c(
  Cordon_v_Middle = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2526$Cordon, sub_kzn2526$Middle, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  Cordon_v_Tip    = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2526$Cordon, sub_kzn2526$Tip,    paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  Middle_v_Tip    = wilcox.test(sub_kzn2526$Middle, sub_kzn2526$Tip,    paired = TRUE)$p.value
)
p.adjust(p_raw_kzn2526, method = "holm")
```
